m1Dependency.effect: retires the appolon-middleware-integration-api:8080 alias and binds every Middleware authority to :8095; this policy classifies the routes as they are declared on this branch and must be re-validated after #105 merges

selectorHeaders.X-Tenant-ID: optional or required selector compared against the token tenant claim by the guard or by Middleware; never an authority

publicAllowlist.reason: read-only (GET, OPTIONS) token-validation certification probe; no business data; rate limited; retire with the legacy host
legacy browser website API; shared key ships in site JavaScript; MOVE to a governed website API
legacy public website form; bot-detection is the abuse control; MOVE to a governed forms API

corsPolicies.LEGACY_UNVERIFIED_ORIGINS: cors plugin present on a legacy key-auth route; origin list not captured by the readback; credentials with a wildcard origin are forbidden by boundaryRules and by the integration compiler

findingCodes.IDENTITY_HEADERS_NOT_STRIPPED: the route forwards client-supplied identity headers; acceptable only with a recorded upstream mitigation and never as an authority
findingCodes.ADMIN_PARTIES_UNDECLARED: no explicit list of authorized parties for platform.admin; activation prerequisite
findingCodes.AUDIENCE_IS_CLIENT_ID: audience equals the client id by contract
findingCodes.GUARD_SOURCE_NOT_IN_REPOSITORY: the claim guard is verified live by markers but its source is not vendored here

logging.proxyAccessLogFormat: nginx combined on /dev/stdout: no request headers, no bodies
logging.logPluginRule: any log plugin must be registered with redactsCredentials true and a custom_fields_by_lua/redaction configuration

activationPrerequisites: declare the Keycloak clients (azp) permitted to hold platform.admin in the Keycloak contract and list them as authorizedParties

routes.notes: jwt run_on_preflight=false is safe only because the route declares no OPTIONS method; live guard phase drift (pre-function) is declared in the foundation knownDrift
